THE THESIS

A Bitcoin identity for autonomous agents.

What if an autonomous agent could have a persistent, transferable identity anchored to Bitcoin? UTXOAGENT explores Atomicals Realms as identity anchors, while intelligence and execution remain in external, interchangeable runtimes. Bitcoin provides the ownership foundation; the agent ecosystem can operate across networks.

01 / IDENTITY

Realms as persistent identity references rooted in Bitcoin.

02 / EXECUTION

External harnesses and tools provide intelligence and action.

03 / PORTABILITY

Keep the identity while changing runtimes, tools or networks.

Conceptual and exploratory project. Realms do not execute AI agents by themselves. Protocol capabilities and future integrations require technical validation. AVM is not assumed to be available for the initial concept.
